source: User-uploaded screenshot of a multi-book aggregate board (columns: Team | Date | Win (Moneyline) | Cover (Spread, Line) | Total Runs (O/U, Line) | If You Bet $20 | Starting Pitcher)
warning: TRANSCRIPTION_RISK_HIGH. These numbers were read from an image by a model, then carried across a context compaction. They were NOT re-read from the image in the session that wrote this file. Every figure here is a model transcription, not a parsed feed. The unblocking artifact remains the source page's 'Export Table Data -> CSV' button.

verification.matchups_and_times: 15/15 EXACT match vs statsapi hydrated schedule for 2026-07-26 (matchup AND first-pitch UTC).
verification.starters: 26/30 exact match vs statsapi probablePitcher (accent-normalized). 3 statsapi-TBD where the board has a name (UNCONFIRMED, treated as TBD -> capped). 1 DIRECT CONFLICT: ATH@MIN home, board=Travis Adams vs statsapi=Joe Ryan; statsapi wins per first-party doctrine.
verification.ml_hold: All 15 games pass the two-sided vig check: hold 2.08%-3.85%, mean 3.03%, every game sum_imp>1 (no arb). A misread price would almost certainly break this.
verification.totals: Displacement test: under_line - over_line >= 0 in 15/15 games (12 positive, 3 zero, ZERO negative). A sampling error would mix signs; it does not. Confirms best-price-across-books display, NOT a two-sided market.

flags: TOTALS: 12/15 games have no identified consensus total (only bounds). total=null for those; NO total lean is emitted for them. Only ATL@BAL 8.5, HOU@CWS 9.5, COL@MIL 7.5 are genuine two-sided numbers.
SPREAD/run-line column was NOT transcribed (side attribution unverified). R3 makes sides DEAD so nothing downstream needs it. Recording the omission rather than inventing values (R1).

ATH@MIN starter identity disputed (Travis Adams vs Joe Ryan). Modeled with statsapi's Joe Ryan. The board's ML may have been priced against a different pitcher — treat any edge in this game as suspect.
3 games modeled with TBD starters (TOR@BOS, KC@DET, LAA@SF) and are therefore capped/excluded by pre-registered rule 3. A shadow slate using the board's unconfirmed names measures the cost.
